newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus sees results rise.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus sees results rise.

text.p: Canal Plus results for 1997 and 1998 would be "significantly higher" on the basis of a comparable structure and the company plans to financially digest its merger with Nethold in 1997 and 1998, its chairman said on Saturday.

Pierre Lescure told Radio Classique that Canal Plus had a sufficient financial health to digest the merger with Nethold -- which will be loss making for a number of years due to start up costs -- in the years 1997 and 1998.
Financial analysts have been expecting the Nethold merger to have a negative impact of 600 million francs on the Canal Plus results in 1997 and expect it to weigh on results until 2000.
Lescure said he wanted to increase the company's stake in Telepiu and also wanted Italian partners to join the pay television group.
